text: What is the name of the tropical cyclone?
What is the official basin-year identifier of the cyclone (e.g., 'AL142024')?
On what date was this report issued?
Who is the lead (first-listed) author of the report?
On what date and time (UTC) is the cyclone estimated to have first become a tropical depression?
From which geographic feature or region did the precursor disturbance originate (e.g., a tropical wave off the coast of Africa)?
On what date did the cyclone make landfall or reach its closest approach?
What was the estimated minimum central pressure?
What was the estimated peak maximum sustained wind in knots?
What peak storm surge height is reported?
How many direct deaths are attributed to the cyclone?
What total damage estimate (in USD) is given for the cyclone?
How is the quality of the genesis (formation) forecast for this cyclone characterized?
Were the official intensity forecast errors larger or smaller than the mean errors of the previous 5-year period?
